title: 82nd Expeditionary Rescue Squadron, No Titles
description: This is the Eighty-Second Expeditionary Rescue Squadron – the Air Force’s first responders for personnel recovery at Combined Joint Task Force Horn Of Africa. Our mission here in Djibouti is to provide p.r. coverage – personnel recovery for the aircraft, in missions that are going on here with both fixed and rotary wing. Sound bites from U.S. Air Force 1st Lt. Eric Hansen, Combat Rescue Officer, 82 ERQS, and U.S. Air Force Tech. Sgt. Clayton Morris, Lead Rigger, 82 ERQS. Available in high definition.
